messages:
marta: Quick share of a noisy bench — comparing intra-node PCIe vs SXM link behavior for multi-GPU inference (70B q4 bring-up). short summary: PCIe pair had slightly better low-latency p50 on short sequences, but SXM w/ NVLink wins overall throughput and p95 for long sequences. NUMA pinning flips some numbers.

julian: can you paste the exact command and env you used? also which instance types?

marta: running on two instance types in the same region: 2x A100-40GB (PCIe) on c5g-like overlay and 2x H100-SXM on h1-like. command:

```
# run_bench.py default harness
export NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0
export NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL
numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0 python run_bench.py \
  --model llama2-70b-q4 \
  --num-gpus 2 \
  --strategy single-process \
  --batch 8 \
  --seq 1024 \
  --kv-cache --profile tokens
```

marta: quick raw numbers (averaged across 3 runs each):
- A100 (PCIe, 2x): p50=11.8ms, p95=42.3ms, avg throughput=240k tokens/s, GPU util ~65%
- H100 (SXM NVLink, 2x): p50=15.9ms, p95=28.6ms, avg throughput=340k tokens/s, GPU util ~82%
- A100 w/ NUMA misbind (no pin): p50=18.2ms, p95=62ms, throughput=180k tokens/s

marta: interestingly, PCIe gave slightly better p50 on short sequences (small KV working set) but p95 balloons on long sequences because host->GPU and inter-GPU PCIe copies become the tail. SXM NVLink moves a lot of that to device p2p and keeps the p95 tight.

sanjay: did you measure NCCL paths? i.e., whether p2p used NVLink vs routed over PCIe?

marta: yes, logs show NVLINK peers present on H100 runs. snippet:
```
# from our topology probe
GPU0 peers: GPU1 (NVLINK x6)
NVLINK: available
NCCL INFO: P2P detected, using NVLINK
```

julian: what about multi-process vs single-process multi-gpu? that can change PCIe staging behavior.

marta: tried both. single-process (intra-process cudaMemcpy) wins on SXM. on PCIe, multi-process with pinned host staging slightly improved throughput (gains ~10%) because it overlapped host->device transfers better.

rachel: did you try forcing no NVLink to isolate effects? e.g., disable p2p so NCCL routes differently.

marta: yes i forced NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=PXN (force PCIe) and ran H100s; p95 jumped to ~55ms and throughput dropped to ~210k tokens/s — basically matched the PCIe box. so NVLink clearly matters for multi-token KV-heavy workloads.

sanjay: any kernel selection notes? were you on fused attention kernels / Triton vs PT custom kernels?

marta: used our optimized fused-attn path on H100 (fast triton kernels + PT fused attention). A100 PCIe run defaulted to the fallback kernel for long seqs due to workspace limits; switching to the smaller workspace fused kernel helped throughput but added CPU overhead. kernel choice explains part of the p50 differences.

marta: also CPU topology mattered: when the process wasn't pinned to the same NUMA node as the GPUs' CPU affinity, we saw extra 4-12ms of latency due to host staging and NUMA remote memory. numactl fixes this.

infra-bot: deploy-log: perf harness v0.9.3 executed on 2025-10-22T14:24:00Z by marta. artifacts -> /runs/1765432100/

julian: nice. action items?

marta: short list:
- add a small ci benchmark that runs 1x short seq and 1x long seq on all instance families we support (PCIe and SXM) to catch regressions.
- add a topology probe step in onboarding that checks NVLINK peers and NUMA layout and emits warnings.
- tune workspace/kernel selection heuristic to prefer smaller-workspace fused kernels on PCIe boxes to reduce p95.

rachel: i'll open a tiny PR to add the probe. also we should add a regression alert if p95 increases >20% vs baseline. :+1:

marta: thanks — i'll push the run artifacts and raw csvs to the run dir and tag infra. full csv attached in artifacts, summary in /runs/1765432100/summary.txt

sanjay: great thread. when we onboard the 70B q4 to Dedicated, we should gate model placement by detected topology (prefer SXM for high-concurrency KV workloads).

marta: agreed. i'll draft a placement policy and share in this thread when ready. :memo:
